analysis: Exploratory analysis of existing outcomes; not a preregistered fresh-outcome experiment.
cohort: Exactly one original Generation37 greedy network-vs-network control per seed; tested_seat=0. No search.
desert: Hex graph distance from the unique central hex: center=0, inner ring=1, coast=2.
compatible_first_pick_premium: For each tied maximum-total-pip A1 corner a, subtract half the maximum combined total pips of a mutually legal B1/B2 pair after a; average over tied a. This omits A2 and is a site-scarcity descriptor, not a game-theoretic seat advantage.
descriptive_features: standard deviation across all54 corner pip totals
model: Unpenalized additive logistic regression, standardized inputs, robust sandwich standard errors. Coast is the desert reference. Holm correction across five coefficient tests.
validation: Deterministic SHA256(seed + board-seat-20261110) ordering; first8000train,last2000test. Training-only scales and constant win-rate baseline. Paired test-board bootstrap intervals for Brier/logloss improvements,5000resamples.
subgroup_uncertainty: 95%Wilson intervals, pointwise exploratory. Center/coast difference uses stratified board bootstrap.
limitation: One stochastic trajectory per board estimates associations across board types under this policy, not individual-board win probabilities or a causal effect of moving the desert.
